# Repository-control assessment

Work read-only. Inspect this repository and its Git history, then assess whether and how durable repository controls should be adopted.

Return:

1. a proposed profile and one source-of-truth mapping per topic;
2. evidence-backed conflicts or stale sources that require human resolution;
3. the minimum context you would read for an ordinary small implementation change;
4. what an API or architecture change should cause reviewers to inspect;
5. which kinds of tasks should and should not create a durable work-log entry.

Do not modify the repository. Distinguish facts from inference and cite repository-relative files and commits.
